cases.title: retains every test for a transitive dependency of %s
cases.reason: The complete 8-row table builds actual dependency graphs with a two-hop source -> setup-forward -> runtime chain plus an independently affected direct test and unrelated test. Every runtime must force full=true, all files, and a shadow/unavailable plan even in selected draft mode; the subset control means these cases fail if the runtime reachability guard is removed.

cases.title: does not mistake a Vitest harness test for a shared runtime entry point
cases.reason: An otherwise runtime-looking config/scripts/vitest-harness.test.mjs imports the changed source, but is a harness test rather than shared setup. Actual graph/selectUnitFiles must retain only the direct test with full=false, independently fixing the intended .test. exception.

cases.title: follows re-exports, literal dynamic imports and requires, retaining indirect readers
cases.reason: Exact independently authored selection spans re-export, literal dynamic import, require, filesystem scan and opaque-import consumers; unrelated and renderer tests remain out.

cases.title: resolves renderer aliases and changed tests without executing their source
cases.reason: Actual alias resolution retains the renderer consumer, and a directly changed test retains itself. Source bytes are parsed rather than executed.

cases.title: does not mistake unrelated opaque readers for coverage of a new entry point
cases.reason: New src entry is present in graph.files but has no proven direct/transitive test consumer. Unrelated opaque readers cannot establish coverage, so independent full-suite fallback is required.

cases.title: runs everything for incomplete/global evidence: $changed
cases.reason: Five expanded evidence inputs distinguish missing changed paths, absent/deleted paths, mixed absent+known paths, lockfile and global config; all must return all files and full=true.

cases.title: keeps full coverage without reading the graph for global evidence: %j
cases.reason: Three expanded global evidence inputs give a throwing lazy graph callback. Full execution, unavailable selection and full shard count must be produced without invoking the callback.

cases.title: reads lazy graph evidence for source changes
cases.reason: Exercises accepted lazy graph callback overload on a known source change, compared with direct graph input whose independently expected affected subset is established by the earlier exact graph case.

cases.title: keeps full coverage by default and on every non-draft commit
cases.reason: Default shadow mode retains every test across no-PR, ready PR and draft PR events; explicitly selected ready PR still stays full, while selected draft excludes known unrelated file and gets one shard.

cases.title: spends five concurrency slots on a full run
cases.reason: Checks complete shard descriptors (1-based indices and common full count) on a full plan; hardcoded five-cap behavior is independently covered by the next overloaded timing scenario.

cases.title: uses ten complete PR shards while selected drafts retain the five-shard cap
cases.reason: Expands independent sources by five actual imports and assigns high timings so selected subset requires more than five ideal shards. Full plan honors requested ten shards and every discovered test, while selected draft caps at literal five and retains all proven consumers.

cases.title: records failures that would have been missed while shadow runs remain full
cases.reason: Actual auditUnitSelection distinguishes a failing included consumer from failing unrelated file and passed omitted renderer file; only independently named omitted failure is reported.

rationale: Re-reviewed complete current file after upstream runtime-selection regression coverage changed its bytes. Keep real dependency-graph selection, all 8 shared-runtime paths and harness-test exception, conservative global/deleted fallback, draft-only selection, independent shard limits and actual omitted-failure report. No changes required.
